items.text: In this team, I can acknowledge a mistake without fear of humiliation.
In this team, I can raise a concern without others thinking less of me.
In this team, I can ask for help without being judged as incompetent.
In this team, I can disagree with a proposed decision without fear of rejection.
In this team, admitting that I am unsure about something would lower others' respect for me.
In this team, questioning an established practice could make me a target of ridicule.
In this team, I would risk being excluded if I expressed a view that others disliked.
